title: Corporate Commercial Legal Secretary
description:
Corporate Commercial Legal Secretary
Norwich, Office Based
Mon-Fri (9am-5pm)

An established and highly regarded law firm is seeking an experienced Legal Secretary to join its Corporate Commercial team in Norwich.

You will be supporting a team of fee earners within the Corporate Commercial department and responsibilities will include:
- Audio and copy typing of legal documents and correspondence
- File management and record keeping
- Administrative and secretarial support
- Billing and client account assistance
- Liaison with clients and third parties

About You:
- Previous legal secretarial experience is essential
- Corporate Commercial experience would be advantageous
- Strong typing and IT skills
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail
- Professional communication skills
- Able to work independently and as part of a team

Benefits:
- Competitive salary
- Profit-share bonus
- Bupa cash plan
- Enhanced pension
- Death in service benefit
- Discounted legal services
- Generous annual leave
- Regular social events

This is an excellent opportunity to join a friendly, supportive firm offering strong benefits and a positive working environment, please contact us today.
